interface_decision.semantic_role: left cosets, their finite quotient carrier, chosen representatives, and the explicit G <-> (G/H) x H coordinate bijection
interface_decision.litex_form: witness props, template-scoped set/function objects, and named algebraic/finite/bijection theorems

proof_spine: A left coset is the image gH represented by a source witness h in H.
Membership in gH identifies the same coset, so the cosets form the range of the projection g |-> gH.
Choose one representative of every coset through function_inverse and extract the residual H-coordinate.
The forward and backward coordinate maps are two-sided inverses, hence a bijection.

prop left_coset_member(G nonempty_set, group &group::Group<G>, H power_set(G), g, x G):
    exist h G st {h $in H, x = group.mul(g, h)}

blocks.name: object_substitution
blocks.accepted_litex:
thm object_substitution:
    ? forall A, B set, f fn(x A) B, x, y A:
        x = y
        =>:
            f(x) = f(y)

thm left_coset_center_mem:
    ? forall G nonempty_set, group &group::Group<G>, H power_set(G), g G:
        $subgroup::is_subgroup(G, group, H)
        =>:
            g $in \left_coset<G, group>(H, g)
    by def $group::group_laws(G, group.mul, group.one, group.inv)
    \left_coset<G, group>(H, g) = {x G: $left_coset_member(G, group, H, g, x)}
    group.one $in H

    witness $left_coset_member(G, group, H, g, g) from group.one

    \left_coset<G, group>(H, x) = {q G: $left_coset_member(G, group, H, x, q)}

    claim:
        ? forall z \left_coset<G, group>(H, x):
            z $in \left_coset<G, group>(H, g)

        group.mul(u, w) $in H

    claim:
        ? forall z \left_coset<G, group>(H, g):
            z $in \left_coset<G, group>(H, x)
        obtain w from $left_coset_member(G, group, H, g, z)
        group.inv(u) $in H
        group.mul(group.inv(u), w) $in H
        release thm group::mul_inv_cancel(G, group.mul, group.one, group.inv, u)
        group.mul(u, group.mul(group.inv(u), w)) = group.mul(group.mul(u, group.inv(u)), w)
        release thm object_substitution(G, G, fn(t G) G {group.mul(g, t)}, group.mul(u, group.mul(group.inv(u), w)), group.mul(group.mul(u, group.inv(u)), w))
        group.mul(g, group.mul(u, group.mul(group.inv(u), w))) = group.mul(g, group.mul(group.mul(u, group.inv(u)), w))
        group.mul(u, group.inv(u)) = group.one
        release thm object_substitution(G, G, fn(t G) G {group.mul(t, w)}, group.mul(u, group.inv(u)), group.one)
        group.mul(group.mul(u, group.inv(u)), w) = group.mul(group.one, w)
        release thm object_substitution(G, G, fn(t G) G {group.mul(g, t)}, group.mul(group.mul(u, group.inv(u)), w), group.mul(group.one, w))
        group.mul(g, group.mul(group.mul(u, group.inv(u)), w)) = group.mul(g, group.mul(group.one, w))
        group.mul(group.one, w) = w

        group.mul(g, group.mul(group.one, w)) = group.mul(g, w)
        group.mul(x, group.mul(group.inv(u), w)) = group.mul(group.mul(g, u), group.mul(group.inv(u), w)) = group.mul(g, group.mul(u, group.mul(group.inv(u), w))) = group.mul(g, group.mul(group.mul(u, group.inv(u)), w)) = group.mul(g, group.mul(group.one, w)) = group.mul(g, w) = z
        witness $left_coset_member(G, group, H, x, z) from group.mul(group.inv(u), w):

        release thm set_builder_member(z, {q G: $left_coset_member(G, group, H, x, q)})

        CarrierC $in {candidate power_set(G): $is_left_coset_of(G, group, H, candidate)}
        by def $is_left_coset_of(G, group, H, CarrierC)
        obtain g from $is_left_coset_of(G, group, H, CarrierC)

        (fn(x G) power_set(G) {\left_coset<G, group>(H, x)})(g) $in fn_range(fn(x G) power_set(G) {\left_coset<G, group>(H, x)})
        CarrierC $in fn_range(fn(x G) power_set(G) {\left_coset<G, group>(H, x)})
    by def:

    claim:

        have by preimage g from CarrierC $in fn_range(fn(x G) power_set(G) {\left_coset<G, group>(H, x)})

        \quotient_group_carrier<G, group>(H) = {candidate power_set(G): $is_left_coset_of(G, group, H, candidate)}

        release thm set_builder_member(CarrierC, {candidate power_set(G): $is_left_coset_of(G, group, H, candidate)})
        CarrierC $in {candidate power_set(G): $is_left_coset_of(G, group, H, candidate)}
    by def:
        ? fn_range(fn(g G) power_set(G) {\left_coset<G, group>(H, g)}) $subset \quotient_group_carrier<G, group>(H)

    g $in \left_coset<G, group>(H, \left_coset_representative<G, group, H>(\left_coset_projection<G, group, H>(g)))
